author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out! Contact via Facebook group DM or comment.

author: Trabahero.PH

author: Jobs.com
title: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote
content: HIRING! author: GoldenProsper Games
title: Hiring 3D Character Artist (Anime Style, Freelance/Contract)
content: GoldenProsper Games is hiring: 3D Character Artist (Anime Style, Freelance/Contract). About us: GoldenProsper Games is an independent game studio from Indonesia building a stylized anime game. Our character designs and art direction are locked, and we are looking for a 3D character artist to bring them to life. The role: You will turn our finished character sheets into game-ready 3D models that match our illustrated art direction. Compensation: Rp3,300,000 – 4,000,000 (about USD 185–225) per character. How to apply: Fill in the form: https://forms.gle/BuDzNhVnpKG8cDGM6 Deadline: 30 october. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST.
